findings.text: Documented legacy client-compat: unbounded oldPlaybackSessionMap ('TODO: Remove after updated mobile versions'); syncLocalSession remaps play_local_* ids and old mobile-client payload shapes. Bounded, well-logged shim.
Duplication: identical user.createUpdateMediaProgressFromPayload block repeated for existing-progress and new-progress branches.
Bounded fallback: invalid sessionJson.updatedAt silently replaced with new Date() for stats day assignment.

Polling-free wait: after ffmpeg.kill(), awaits a 500ms setTimeout instead of the ffmpeg exit event ('so that the output file is unlocked') — may be insufficient on slow Windows fs teardown; intent documented.
Backup failures only logged, task proceeds: failed first-track backup + subsequent destructive truncation means original tracks can be lost while task is marked finished.

taskFailedString + setFailed + removeTask pattern repeated five times across two managers; line 125 logs '[AudioMetadataManager]' inside AbMergeManager (copy-paste); FFMPEG_CANCELED detected via stringly-typed error.message.
Class name typo 'AudioMetadataMangaer' exported as the module.
imageExtensions contains '.jiff' (typo for '.jfif') so .jfif covers are never removed by removeOldCovers; legacy `var` throughout lines 48-56,177-198.

storeCoverWithItem-else-metadataPath cover-dir branching copy-pasted three times (saveEmbeddedCoverArt, saveEbookCoverArt, downloadCoverFromUrlNew) instead of reusing getCoverDirectory; copies differ subtly.
